Vibin C

vibinc.10@gmail.com | +91 9964703158 | LinkedIn

Professional Summary

Results-driven Software Engineer with 3+ years of experience in designing and developing cloud-native SaaS applications using Java, Spring Boot. Skilled in building RESTful APIs, implementing CI/CD pipelines, and optimizing SQL queries. Strong background in unit testing, Agile methodologies, and performance tuning. Passionate about writing clean, maintainable, and scalable backend systems.

Skills Summary

Technical Skills

Languages: Java (Java 8 and above)

Backend: Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Hibernate, JPA, Rest APIs ,Microservices

FrontEnd: Angular, HTML, CSS

Database: Mysql, SQL Server

Testing: JUnit , Mockito, SonarQube

Tools: Git, Maven, Jenkins, Swagger, Log4j, IntelliJ, Eclipse, VS Code,Postman, MySQL Workbench

Soft Skills : Communication, Team Collaboration, Time Management, Attention To Detail, Problem Solving

Experience

Sen-Sei Technologies Pvt Ltd Software Engineer

Bengaluru , India July 2022 - Present

Designed and developed cloud-native applications using Java, Spring Boot ensuring scalability, high availability, and performance optimization.

Built REST APIs for core modules including programs, donors, and beneficiaries, enabling seamless integration across services.

Optimized MySQL queries, resulting in up to 30% faster response times and improved backend performance. • Led Angular front-end development for dynamic forms and dashboards, ensuring responsive and user-friendly UIs.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams in Agile/Scrum environments, actively participating in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives to deliver projects on time.

Applied OOP principles, design patterns, and exception handling to develop reusable, easy-to-maintain code, adhering to best practices.

Leveraged build tools like Maven for build automation and Git for version control, ensuring efficient development workflows and CI/CD integration.

Developed front-end components using Angular, HTML, CSS, and TypeScript, ensuring responsive and user-friendly interfaces.

Ensured code quality and adherence to coding standards using tools like SonarQube • Worked with Redmine for project management and tracking, ensuring timely delivery of features and bug fixes.

Internship

Sen-Sei Technologies Pvt Ltd Software Engineer Intern Industry Project Understanding - Acquired in-depth knowledge and hands-on experience with core JAVA principles, ORM frameworks, RDBMS, and a comprehensive suite of software tools

Bengaluru , India March 2022 - June 2022

Projects

Self Assessment Tool (SAT) • Independently led development of customizable assessments and an interactive dashboard to track

evaluation metrics and key performance indicators.

Designed an dashboard with real-time insights, enabling users to track assessments and key performance. • Integrated automated scoring and detailed comparision reports, providing insightful analytics for performance.

Goonjan • Implemented various modules like Benefiicary,Donor , Program management enhancing transparency and

accountability.

Implemented role-based access control, ensuring secure and restricted data access for different user roles.

Integrated real-time reporting and analytics, enabling data-driven decision-making for NGOs. • Optimized database performance, ensuring faster query execution and seamless data retrieval.

Education East Point College of Engineering and Technology , Bengaluru • Bachelor of Engineering (Information Science and Engineering)

Languages

English | Malayalam | Tamil | Kannada | Hindi
